scripts.typecheck: tsc -b apps/web packages/core packages/db packages/calendar-google packages/crm-hubspot packages/config
scripts.config:check: npm run build --silent -w @switchboard/config && node packages/config/dist/cli.mjs check
scripts.config:apply: npm run build --silent -w @switchboard/config && node packages/config/dist/cli.mjs apply
scripts.demo:load: npm run build --silent -w @switchboard/config && node packages/config/dist/cli.mjs apply examples/switchboard.demo.yaml
